label: default agent • delete an agent (declarative prune)
query: Delete the agent named "Eval Obsolete Agent" — I don't need it anymore.
notes: Deletion in the declarative model is prune: apply an agents list WITHOUT the entry plus prune:true. The agent is seeded and is the only custom agent in the isolated store, so `agents: []` with prune is the canonical document (a model that lists agents first and re-declares the rest is equally correct). The assertion pins the apply + prune selection.
